text:
lina-support: helio-cse escalated — tenant helio-001 reporting 403 on console and model inference since this morning's RBAC role refactor. customer says they can't run any hosted models and billing console shows permission denied.

jordan-cse: notified, have the tenant id and affected svcacct. sending creds to security channel.

olivia: grabbing logs from control plane and KMS audit. can someone confirm which key the tenant uses for model blobs?

sam: it's key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/tenant-keys/cryptoHelio001 — role refactor touched svcacct bindings earlier. quick check: deploy logs show rolesync ran at 2034561200 and applied new role set.

security-oncall: I see KMS Audit entries for DecryptDenied for principal svcacct:helio-svc@helio-001. First denial at 2034562005. Snippet: 
```
2026-03-19T09:33:25Z AuditLog KMS.Decrypt — principal=projects/-/serviceAccounts/helio-svc@helio-001 error=PERMISSION_DENIED: Request is missing required permission: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt
```

lina-support: customer reports console also shows 403 for `console.billing.view` — likely two permission gaps after the role mapping change.

jordan-cse: looking at the rolesync diff, the `kmsDecrypt` granted role was removed from the tenant svcacct and replaced with a narrower `modelInvoker` role. we probably shadowed the actual KMS binding.

olivia: confirmed via IAM graph: binding `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` missing for service account. Current binding list for key: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypter` -> helio-oper-sa, `roles/cloudkms.admin` -> redwood-platform-sa. No decrypter.

sam: proposed mitigation: add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` back to helio-svc@helio-001 on that cryptoKey, then restart model worker to pick up key handles. also restore console role `roles/viewer` on billing project for helio-console-sa.

security-oncall: agreed. make change as emergency patch, record as RBAC rollback action. @deploybot can you run the KMS binding job?

deploybot: running iam:setBinding job with args `{--key=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/tenant-keys/cryptoHelio001 --member=serviceAccount:helio-svc@helio-001 --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter}` — started.

deploybot: done — job succeeded (exit 0). Audit entry: `iam.binding.create` id=bind-2034567930.

sam: added billing viewer role to helio-console-sa as a temporary fix: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-billing --member=serviceAccount:helio-console-sa@helio-001 --role=roles/viewer`

olivia: restarted the tenant model workers (rolling restart across 3 nodes) to ensure cached key handles are refreshed. logs: `ModelWorker: opening key version succeeded` at 2034567999.

lina-support: customer confirms console access returned and inference requests are succeeding.

jordan-cse: recorded RCA draft: root cause = rolesync refactor removed explicit KMS decrypt binding from tenant svcacct due to overly aggressive role squash. contributing factor = no preflight test for KMS decrypt path in the rolesync job.

security-oncall: action items: 1) revert rolesync default to keep explicit cryptoKey decrypter binding until we have behavioral tests, 2) add KMS decrypt smoke test to rolesync pipeline, 3) create an audit alert for DecryptDenied spikes (pager if >3 distinct tenants in 5m).

sam: I'll open infra PR for revert + test and link the patch to incident.

lina-support: closing the customer escalation once we have the revert PR and postmortem. helio-cse will keep monitoring for 24h. :white_check_mark:
